Hi Lydia — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a proposal that aligns with BrightLane’s runway and procurement timeline.

Recap (what we heard)
- Initial model: redwood-1-large for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in customer support use case.
- Expected production ramp: ~15M tokens/month for Q4 (pilot), scaling to ~45M tokens/month within 6 months. Burst concurrency ~10–15 r/s, typical seq len ~800 tokens.
- Latency target: p95 <= 350ms; durability SLOs required for support and audit logs.
- Procurement window: target PO in ~6 weeks if pricing aligns.

Concrete asks for you (so we can price):
1) Confirm target budget range for the next 6 months (ballpark is fine).
2) Is BrightLane eligible/interested in our startup program (raised < $5M)? If yes, we can include a $15k platform credit.
3) Are you able to consider a committed-use structure (3/12/36 month) in exchange for steeper unit discounts? If yes, any preference on term length?
4) Any specific compliance/contract requirements we should include in the term sheet?

Proposed follow-ups from our side: we’ll sketch 3 commitment scenarios (starter, standard, multi-year) with net $/1M-token equivalencies and an example invoice schedule. I’ve attached an executive pricing summary and the detailed XLS.

Next step: if you can reply with the budget range + confirm startup program eligibility and procurement cadence, we’ll turn around options by Wednesday.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Diego — really helpful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Token profile: agree with the ramp: 15M/mo pilot -> ~45M/mo by month 6. The pilot will run on a trimmed prompt set (avg 650 tokens).
- Budget runway: BrightLane has $80k allocated for AI infra over the next 6 months (pilot + initial scale). We could stretch to $120k if we secure committed discounts or credits.
- Startup program: we raised $1.8M last round, so yes — eligible. We’d like to see a startup credit included.
- Procurement: procurement wants a simple term sheet and a PO-ready invoice; procurement review typically takes 4–6 weeks. Happy to route the term sheet to procurement once we have the numbers.

Ask from us: Can you show a 12-month committed option that hits <$1,000 per 1M tokens effective, and a 36-month path that goes to <$750 per 1M (after credits/commits)? If those are realistic, we’ll prioritize Redwood in vendor evaluation. Also include any ops/observability credits for the pilot.

Cheers,

Hi Lydia / procurement team — appreciate the quick clarity. Based on your budget and Ben/Marissa’s internal guidance, here are three concrete proposal lanes we can put into a PO-ready term sheet. Numbers are illustrative net effective $/1M tokens after discounts and the $15k startup credit applied pro-rata for the pilot period. Detailed line items will appear in the attached "redwood-pricing-v1.xlsx" and the term sheet (DocuSign) link below.

Option A — Starter (low-commit)
- Term: 3 months (pilot)
- Commitment: 45M total tokens (15M/mo) minimum usage guarantee during pilot
- Startup credit: $15,000 applied to pilot invoice(s)
- Discount: 15% off list -> effective $/1M tokens ~ $1,360
- Good if you want minimal lock-in and fast procurement.

Option B — Standard (12-month, procurement-friendly)
- Term: 12 months
- Commitment: 540M tokens (45M/mo steady-state estimate) or equivalent annual spend commit
- Discount: 30% off list with a 6-month step-up protection; effective $/1M tokens ~ $1,120 before credit; after $15k startup credit applied to Q1 the blended effective hits <= $1,000 / 1M tokens given BrightLane’s projected burn.
- Billing: monthly invoicing with single-PO possible.

Option C — Multi-year (36-month, unit-econ focused)
- Term: 36 months
- Commitment: 2Bn+ tokens over term (annual floors apply)
- Discount: 45% off list with CPI floor and formal rollback protections; effective $/1M tokens ~ $750 after credits and volume bands.
- Additional: optional dedicated capacity quote and extended SLA available for an add-on fee.

Other items:
- Observability/ops credit: we can include up to 40 hours of onboarding/observability support and an ops credit to cover initial tracing/ingestion work for the pilot.
- Procurement deliverables: I’ve attached the pricing XLS and an executive summary. If you’re aligned, I’ll send a DocuSign term sheet (RED-3456) for signature and a PO-ready invoice template.

Next steps:
1) Reply with which option you want us to put into a term sheet (A/B/C). If B or C, confirm billing cadence preference (monthly vs quarterly) and whether you need a credit card or net-30 PO.
2) If you want the 12mo (B), we’ll issue a draft DocuSign within 48 hours and route for legal review.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 20-minute follow-up to walk the numbers with procurement.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
